# News24
> South African news site covering breaking news, politics, business, sport, lifestyle, and opinion.

News24 is a major South African digital news publication. It publishes national and international reporting, live coverage, analysis, opinion, newsletters, multimedia, and topic-specific verticals including business, sport, lifestyle, and investigative journalism.

## Main News Sections
- [Home](https://www.news24.com/): Front page with top stories, breaking news, and featured coverage.
- [South Africa](https://www.news24.com/news24/southafrica): National news, crime, politics, courts, and public affairs coverage.
- [World](https://www.news24.com/news24/world): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, and major global developments.
- [Politics](https://www.news24.com/news24/politics): South African political news, parties, elections, parliament, and policy reporting.
- [Opinion](https://www.news24.com/news24/opinions): Columns, analysis, editorials, and commentary from contributors and newsroom writers.
- [Investigations](https://www.news24.com/news24/investigations): In-depth investigative reporting on corruption, governance, and accountability.
- [Good News](https://www.news24.com/news24/community-newspaper/good-news): Positive community-focused stories and uplifting local reporting.

## Business
- [Business](https://www.news24.com/fin24): Business news hub covering markets, companies, economy, and personal finance.
- [Economy](https://www.news24.com/fin24/economy): Reporting on inflation, growth, policy, labour, and macroeconomic developments.
- [Companies](https://www.news24.com/fin24/companies): Corporate news, earnings, executive moves, and company-specific developments.
- [Markets](https://www.news24.com/fin24/markets): Market updates, equities, currencies, commodities, and investment news.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.news24.com/fin24/personal-finance): Consumer finance, savings, debt, tax, and money management guidance.
- [Tech](https://www.news24.com/fin24/tech): Technology industry news, digital trends, telecoms, and platform developments.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.news24.com/sport): Sports news, live coverage, results, analysis, and commentary.
- [Rugby](https://www.news24.com/sport/rugby): Rugby union news, match reports, squads, and tournament coverage.
- [Cricket](https://www.news24.com/sport/cricket): Cricket news, series coverage, player updates, and match analysis.
- [Soccer](https://www.news24.com/sport/soccer): Football news, leagues, transfers, and South African soccer coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.news24.com/sport/tennis): Tennis tournament coverage, player news, and match reporting.
- [Motorsport](https://www.news24.com/sport/motorsport): Motorsport news, race coverage, and driver developments.

## Lifestyle & Entertainment
- [Life](https://www.news24.com/life): Lifestyle coverage including wellness, relationships, food, travel, and culture.
- [Arts and Entertainment](https://www.news24.com/life/arts-and-entertainment): Entertainment news, celebrity coverage, film, television, and music stories.
- [Wellness](https://www.news24.com/life/wellness): Health, mental wellbeing, fitness, and practical wellness advice.
- [Food](https://www.news24.com/life/food): Recipes, restaurant features, cooking ideas, and food trends.
- [Travel](https://www.news24.com/life/travel): Travel inspiration, destination guides, and tourism-related features.
- [Relationships](https://www.news24.com/life/relationships): Advice and features on dating, family, and personal relationships.

## Multimedia & Special Formats
- [Videos](https://www.news24.com/video): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and visual news coverage.
- [Podcasts](https://www.news24.com/news24/podcasts): News24 podcast hub with current affairs and topical audio series.
- [Newsletters](https://www.news24.com/news24/newsletters): Email newsletters covering major beats, analysis, and curated briefings.
- [Magazines](https://www.news24.com/drum): Magazine content and entertainment features from partner titles.
- [TrueLove](https://www.news24.com/truelove): Lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and culture content from TrueLove.
- [KickOff](https://www.news24.com/kickoff): Football-focused reporting, analysis, and South African soccer news.

## Opinion, Analysis & Features
- [Analysis](https://www.news24.com/news24/analysis): Deeper reporting and contextual analysis on major news events.
- [Voices](https://www.news24.com/news24/opinions/voices): First-person opinion pieces and commentary from diverse contributors.
- [Editorials](https://www.news24.com/news24/opinions/editorials): Editorial positions and institutional commentary from the publication.
- [Columnists](https://www.news24.com/news24/opinions/columnists): Recurring opinion columns from named writers and analysts.
- [Special Reports](https://www.news24.com/news24/specialreports): Curated coverage pages for major ongoing stories and themes.

## Consumer & Community
- [Parent24](https://www.news24.com/parent): Parenting advice, family life coverage, and child-focused resources.
- [Property24](https://www.news24.com/property24): Property news, housing market coverage, and real estate listings content.
- [Careers24](https://www.news24.com/careers24): Job listings, career advice, and employment-related resources.
- [Health24](https://www.news24.com/health24): Consumer health information, medical news, and wellness guidance.
- [Business Insider SA](https://www.news24.com/businessinsider): Business Insider South Africa reporting on business, tech, and lifestyle.
- [Community Newspapers](https://www.news24.com/news24/community-newspaper): Local and community newspaper content from around South Africa.

## User Services & Account
- [Subscribe](https://www.news24.com/news24/subscribe): Subscription options for premium journalism and member access.
- [Sign In](https://www.news24.com/news24/login): Account login for subscribers and registered users.
- [News24 Help](https://www.news24.com/news24/about-us/contact-us): Contact and support information for readers and subscribers.
- [About Us](https://www.news24.com/news24/about-us): Information about News24, its newsroom, and editorial mission.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.news24.com/news24/terms-and-conditions): Legal terms governing use of the site and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.news24.com/news24/privacy-policy): Privacy practices, data handling, and user rights information.
